answer.says: Ramesh, the kadhi looks well made. Set me a plate; I have sat long enough over the desk.
answer.thought: The body has its own right to the table, which I had neglected this morning in the study. The food is simple, but the heat has made the rice and the cooling spiced yogurt a necessary reconciliation between the spirit and the flesh. I will eat, and then the rest is due before the Directorate.
